title: Ross's Game Dungeon: Deus Ex - Human Revolution
summary: Ross Scott's Game Dungeon episode critiques Deus Ex: Human Revolution, looking at its design, politics and visual style. It is part of his series of opinionated game reviews.
why: HN commenters recommend it as a witty critique of the game, and cite it in discussions of the yellow filter in games.
